messages:
maria: Hey — I'm working on the Console > Observability cost section. The current cost aggregation example returns total spend per dashboard panel and folks are confused how it maps to $/token. Can we clarify the intended example?

nate: Short answer: the panel should show $/token (average cost), not just total spend. The current prom query is sum(token_cost) which is misleading for per-request analysis.

sam: Agreed. UI folks also asked whether to show both total spend and unit cost. I'd suggest keeping the example focused on unit cost and adding a small note about total spend.

maria: Good call. Can someone propose a minimal prom/grafana expression we can paste into the docs? I want to avoid heavy math in text.

nate: Use this to get $/token (per minute window):
```
sum(rate(token_cost_total[5m])) / sum(rate(token_count_total[5m]))
```
That yields cost per token averaged over the window.

olivia: Nice. For the SDK snippet we should show how to compute $/request too — multiply by tokens-per-request from the trace hook. I'll add a tiny node example.

maria: Perfect. Two asks for the PR: (1) replace the grafana query in docs with nate's expression and short explanation, (2) add a small Node.js SDK snippet that shows deriving $/request from trace metadata and tokens.

sam: Also fix the link in the note that currently points to the old tracing-hooks page (broken anchor). I'll update the link to /docs/observability/tracing-hooks#token-metrics.

maria: I'll open the PR and paste the snippets. tagging @nate and @olivia for review. ETA EOD.

docs-bot: New PR created by maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — title: "console: clarify cost aggregation + add $/request SDK example"

nate: Quick LGTM on the grafana query. One small nit: annotate the window (5m) in the docs copy so readers know why we use rate().

olivia: I'll draft the Node snippet. Proposed code:
```js
// compute cost per request from trace payload
const tokens = trace.meta.tokens; // integer
const costPerToken = 0.000012; // from billing metric
const costPerRequest = tokens * costPerToken;
return { tokens, costPerToken, costPerRequest }
```
I'll make it slightly more explicit in the PR.

maria: Thanks. One more: can we add a short callout about sampling? Many customers sample traces which affects per-request dashboards. Suggest a 1-2 sentence caveat.

sam: Good reminder — add a bolded caveat under the example: "If traces are sampled, per-request cost must be adjusted by sampling rate." and point to the sampling docs.

maria: Ok I pushed initial changes. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821/files

docs-bot: PR 4821 updated: added Node snippet and link fix.

nate: Reviewing now. If all good I'll merge after doc lint passes.

maria: Thanks team — merging after tests. Will follow up if any post-merge tweaks pop up.
